changes: Name normalised to Gadādhara (Gajādhara is almost certainly a mistake for the common name Gadādhara; ja/da confusion). Confidence lowered to medium.
Place normalised to the village of Jñādi (jñādigrāmābhidhāne). Residence set to the same, but this is uncertain.
Notes expanded: the corrupt passage and the lacuna.

purpose: For Viṣṇu's satisfaction (viṣṇututyartham = tuṣṭyartham) and to destroy bad thinking (kubuddhināśāya).
notes: The colophon is a corrupt verse. It probably reads: śrīviṣṇutuṣṭyartham idaṃ purāṇaṃ kubuddhināśāya ... likhitaṃ phaladaṃ puṃsāṃ jñānamuktyabhivāñchatām / jñādigrāmābhidhāne śrīgadādharadvijanmanā. 'Gajādhara' is most likely Gadādhara. The as-written form is kept. 'śubhaphaṇabhṛmithautra' follows the lacuna (///) and is corrupt. It contains phaṇabhṛt ('serpent', which can stand for 8 in a chronogram) and may hide a date such as a year name or a chronogram. However, no reading can be made with confidence, so no date is recorded. 'gṛhavrata nāma' is unclear. It could be a corrupt epithet, or part of the place or person description. It is not treated as a person. The place-name Jñādigrāma is not identified.
